characters.name: TIIU
characters.description: Väike inimene, tüdruk. Tal on kollased juuksed, mis on krunnis, seljas sinine kleit ja punased kingad. Tal on suured rõõmsad silmad ja armas naeratus. Ta on uudishimulik ja sõbralik. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: MARKUS
characters.description: Väike inimene, poiss. Tal on lühikesed pruunid juuksed, seljas roheline T-särk ja lühikesed püksid ning sinised tossud. Tal on laiad rõõmsad silmad ja avatud naeratus. Ta on energiline ja abivalmis. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Mängutuba
locations.description: Cozy children's playroom with light yellow walls, a light wooden floor. In the center, there's a small round wooden table with two small wooden chairs. On the back wall, there's a red wooden shelf filled with colorful art supplies like paint tubes, paintbrushes, and drawing books. A single rectangular window on the left wall shows a glimpse of a sunny green garden outside. The room is brightly lit by soft natural light. Cartoon style.

locations.name: Päikeseline aed
locations.description: A sunny, vibrant green garden with lush grass. In the background, there's a large, old oak tree. Several colorful flowers (red, yellow, blue) are blooming in small clusters around the garden. A bright blue sky with a few fluffy white clouds. A small wooden easel with a blank white canvas or paper is placed on the grass. The overall atmosphere is cheerful and calm. Cartoon style.

pages.scene: Tiiu and Markus are sitting at the small round wooden table in the playroom, looking thoughtful. The red shelf with art supplies is visible on the back wall. Warm sunlight streams from the window on the left. The room has light yellow walls and a light wooden floor.

Tiiu and Markus are still sitting at the table in the playroom, now smiling brightly at each other, Tiiu pointing excitedly towards the art supplies on the red shelf. Warm sunlight streams from the window. The room has light yellow walls and a light wooden floor.

Tiiu and Markus are standing by the red wooden shelf in the playroom. Tiiu is holding a tube of blue paint, and Markus is holding a paintbrush. They are picking more art supplies from the shelf, looking happy. Warm sunlight streams from the window. The room has light yellow walls and a light wooden floor.

Tiiu and Markus are now standing on the vibrant green grass in the sunny garden. They have just arrived and are carrying their small box of art supplies (paints, brushes). A small wooden easel is visible nearby. The garden has a large oak tree in the background and colorful flowers. Bright blue sky above.

Tiiu and Markus are walking slowly on the vibrant green grass in the sunny garden, holding their art supplies. They are looking around at the colorful flowers and the large oak tree, trying to decide where to set up their easel and what to paint. The small wooden easel is still nearby. Bright blue sky above.

Tiiu and Markus are both standing at the small wooden easel in the sunny garden. A blank white paper is on the easel. Markus is holding a paintbrush, dipping it into a small palette of paints. Tiiu is holding a different brush, looking at the blank paper with anticipation. The garden has a large oak tree in the background and colorful flowers. Bright blue sky above.

Tiiu and Markus are both painting at the easel in the sunny garden. The paper on the easel now has green grass painted at the bottom and some colorful (red, yellow) flowers emerging from it. Markus is painting the grass, and Tiiu is carefully adding a yellow flower. They are focused and smiling. The garden has a large oak tree in the background and colorful flowers. Bright blue sky above.

pages.text: NENDE PILT ON NÜÜD VÄGA ILUS.
pages.scene: Tiiu and Markus are standing back from the easel in the sunny garden, admiring their finished painting. The painting on the easel shows vibrant green grass and several colorful flowers. Both children have big, proud smiles. The garden has a large oak tree in the background and colorful flowers. Bright blue sky above.

Tiiu and Markus are hugging each other gently next to their beautiful finished painting on the easel in the sunny garden. They are laughing happily and looking at their artwork. The sun shines brightly. The garden has a large oak tree in the background and colorful flowers. Bright blue sky above.
